variants.headline: Still in view: party divides in two
variants.sub: A split in {party} has produced the new party {splinter}.
variants.body:
The party {party} has split, with {splinter} the new breakaway party. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

Workers deserve political organisations that take their interests seriously, whether those organisations stand together or apart. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
